principles.t: Do it by hand once, automate it the second time.
principles.why: If a task comes back, it gets a script. The first time teaches me what the script should do.
I design for the user who is offline, the retry that arrives twice and the server that dies mid-request.
A graph ends most debates faster than an opinion does.

principles.t: Write it down before building it.
principles.why: A one-page design doc saves a week of rework and lets others build without waiting on me.
My own task can wait an hour. A teammate stuck for a day costs more.
